On 17 October 2025, I gave the keynote “Speaking Machines and Living Languages” at [Breakthroughs: Cutting-edge research in the humanities and social sciences](https://inicjatywadoskonalosci.uw.edu.pl/en/breakthroughs-2025/) at the University of Warsaw.

The conference brought together researchers working across the humanities and social sciences as part of the university’s Excellence Initiative – Research University programme. My keynote explored the relationship between speech technology, linguistic diversity, and the living languages that these technologies increasingly mediate.

It was a pleasure to contribute to a programme showcasing the breadth of interdisciplinary research taking place at the University of Warsaw.
